title: Bind calculation, authorization and acceptance to identifiable inputs
context: The whole-contract review found that a mutable dataset descriptor, a request ID and an arbitrary passing report could each identify multiple different outcomes.
decision: Use immutable bounded market inputs, correlated asynchronous terminal messages and a separate core-authorized mutation identity. Bind task and release evidence to effective owner decisions, the actual platform, source revision and retained observations. Preserve explicit synthetic selection as a local preference. Never substitute an unavailable source.
authority: ADR 0007 assigns engineering choices to the development AI. The owner selected restart behavior, deletion and backup handling, permitted data uses and platform qualification order on 2026-11-18.

alternatives.option: Identify inputs by dataset revision alone.
alternatives.reason: A selected window, warm-up range or open-bar observation can change the calculation even within one dataset revision.

alternatives.option: Gate Windows exploration on all paid real sessions.
alternatives.reason: The owner requires local Ubuntu qualification first and requires the paid or connected real sessions at release.

consequences: New wire behavior must negotiate support and keep legacy reads usable. Registration, authorization and implemented behavior have separate states.
Current synthetic reads and release qualification logic get executable regressions. Future product journeys retain distinct implementation and real-environment gates.
revisit_when: A concrete provider cannot freeze or identify its input, a new data use is proposed, or live qualification requires a different evidence chain.
